paragraphs.text: Plugins for DeepSeek Harness
# DeepSeek Harness Plugins
English | 日本語 | 中文
Open-source plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), maintained by langify-org.
## Plugins
| Package                                                | Description
| `@langify-org/dsh-browser`         | A Chromium on the host in right-sidebar tabs, shared with the

model, that keeps running with no page open. Not published yet. |
| `@langify-org/dsh-code-server`
| Edit the session's working folder in code-server inside DSH.

|
| `@langify-org/dsh-greet`             | Example and template that reg

isters a `greet` tool. Not published.                                                            |
|
`@langify-org/dsh-side-chat`     | Ask a side question beside a conversation, in a fork shown in th

e right sidebar.                                              |
| `@langify-org/dsh-tasks`
| Run justfile recipes from a Tasks tab in the right sidebar, in a terminal tab.

|
| `@langify-org/dsh-tmux`               | A terminal tab per conver
sation on tmux, shared with the model, that outlives reloads and restarts.
tion on tmux, shared with the model, that outlives reloads and restarts.                           |
